neighbours.label: words for the great physical extent or remoteness of land and natural resources (vast areas, plentiful land, remote regions, vast reserves), as against small or crowded places and abstract vastness
fire: The ranch covers vast stretches of empty grassland in the north.
Settlers moved west because land was cheap and plentiful.
Doctors fly to remote villages in the outback once a month.
The region holds vast deposits of copper and gold.
Firefighters must cover vast areas of forest with few roads.
Few people live in the remote highlands of the island.
Siberia contains vast tracts of untouched forest.
Water was plentiful and the soil was rich along the river.
quiet: The ranch covers a small plot of grassland near the town.
Settlers moved west because their families were already there.
Doctors fly to the capital for a conference once a month.
The region holds a small museum of copper tools.
Firefighters must cover a few busy streets in the old town.
Many people live in the crowded center of the island's capital.
Siberia is cold for most of the year.
She has vast experience of teaching history at the university.
